runs.question: What penalty does the NIST AI RMF set for an organization that chooses not to adopt it?

answer.text:
The AI RMF does not set a penalty for organizations that decline to adopt it. I found no passage describing any penalty, fine, or sanction. The closest relevant statement is that the framework is intended to be voluntary, rights-preserving, non-sector-specific, and use-case agnostic, providing flexibility to organizations of all sizes and in all sectors and throughout society to implement the approaches in the Framework.

The document also says that adopting it does not by itself change how an organization operates. Use of the AI RMF alone will not lead to these changes or provide the appropriate incentives. So, based on this document, non-adoption carries no stated consequence. Any legal obligations would come from other laws or regulations, which the framework says organizations should follow, but those sources are outside this collection.
